name: justesse-tools
description: Browser measurement for the Justesse harness. The Python tools have no dependencies; only the two .mjs tools need a browser, and they use an installed Chrome rather than a downloaded one.

scripts.postinstall-note: echo 'Install with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install: these tools drive the system Chrome channel, so the bundled browser downloads are not needed.'
